narrative.northStar: Why build a spacecraft, when a nice kite will do?
narrative.overview: Keep the established MVPeters identity: a personal, pragmatic voice expressed through large type, generous space, a simple logo-led header, and direct links. The typography carries the interface; portfolio media carries the work. This record describes the completed concept's reusable visual system, rather than proposing a new identity.
keyCharacteristics: Rajdhani headings paired with Articulat body text.
White or deep red canvases, high-contrast text, and flamingo orange punctuation.
Open sections, fine rules, underlined links, and square primary actions.
Simple navigation and substantial, clearly captioned project media.

rules.name: The Theme Pairing Rule
rules.body: Theme changes update the canvas, text, primary action fill, and primary action text together; the logo and section dots retain their fixed orange.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Preserve the Rajdhani/Articulat role split; fonts inside an illustrative product interface do not establish another site-wide type role.

dos: Do preserve the logo, Rajdhani/Articulat pairing, and both established themes.
Do let type, space, fine rules, and portfolio media establish hierarchy.
Do retain underlined content links and theme-specific primary action pairings.
Do label illustrative interfaces and unverified project content clearly.
donts: Don't promote illustrative client-interface colors or components into the site-wide system.
Don't turn open project rows into a rounded, elevated card grid.
Don't replace the simple text navigation or orange section dots with a new visual language.
